mechanics.name: Bada Bada Boom
mechanics.currentEffect: After completing 20% worth of Generator repairs, the perk activates. While active, use the Active Ability button next to a Window to install a Trap that remains for up to 40/50/60 seconds. When the Killer vaults through the trapped Window, they suffer 50% Hindered for 6 seconds. The trap ends after triggering or timing out, and all Survivors see the trapped Window's yellow Aura.
activation: While active, use the Active Ability button next to a Window to install the trap.
Ends/deactivates when: The trap ends when triggered or when its timer expires.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.4.0): Introduced with a 20% repair threshold and 40/50/60-second trap duration.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: After enough Generator repair, trap a Window to Hinder the Killer when they vault through it.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: The trap is consumed on trigger; another requires qualifying progress and installation.
specialInteractions: The Killer is Hindered when vaulting through the trapped Window.
All Survivors see the trapped Window's yellow Aura.

editorial.summary: After 20% generator repair, trap a Window; if the Killer vaults it, they suffer 50% Hindered for 6 seconds.
useCases: Trap a powerful Window the Killer is likely to vault during chase.
Create a massive slowdown that lets a Survivor leave the tile after the Killer follows.
Mark the trapped Window for teammates through its yellow Aura.
counters: The Killer must vault the trapped Window before the timer expires.
Some Killers can play the tile without ever vaulting.
Requires prior generator repair and a good Window location.
pros: Can affect another Survivor's chase, not only your own.
cons: Experienced Killers may route around it.
analysis: Bada Bada Boom ranks this position because the successful trigger is excellent but hard to force. A Killer vaulting the trapped Window eats a 50% Hindered effect for six seconds, enough to completely break many chase sequences.
The low repair requirement means charging it is not the problem. The real challenge is predicting a Window the Killer will actually vault before the trap expires.
Good map knowledge raises the ceiling because some strong structures naturally encourage Killer vaults. The yellow Aura also lets teammates recognize the trapped resource.
It remains mid-B because many Killers can refuse the interaction. A trap that never fires creates no chase swing regardless of how impressive the number looks.
editorial.verdict: A brutal Window trap when the Killer cooperates. Bada Bada Boom has huge payoff and unreliable agency, which makes it a specialist rather than a default chase perk.
